translation.src: [STREET] Maka-transparency gyud ni, dili ba mao ang pag- sharing sa mga details?
translation.tgt: Transparency is important. Can't we share at least some details?

translation.src: [FORMAL] Gidaku niya ang iyang tingug arun madungug
translation.tgt: She made her voice loud enough to be heard

translation.src: [FORMAL] Di ku kahangad kay mitikig akung liug
translation.tgt: I cannot bend my head upwards because I have a stiff neck

translation.src: [STREET] Ayaw ko sabiha, pero mahimut-an pa na sa gil-ubos sa merkado.
translation.tgt: I don't know exactly. It was somewhere near the market.

translation.src: [FORMAL] Ang tag-iya ra ang adunay access niini
translation.tgt: Only the owner has access to this

translation.src: [FORMAL] Bisag balistahun (ibalista) pa ning akung bulsa, wa giyuy taya
translation.tgt: You may turn my pocket inside out, but you won’t find a penny.†

translation.src: [FORMAL] Muhutwang ang iro ug makakitag panulay
translation.tgt: Dogs howl when they see devils

translation.src: [FORMAL] Kami mosulay sa pagkontak sa usa ka tawo gikan sa imong grupo.
translation.tgt: We will try to contact someone from your group.

translation.src: [FORMAL] Kinahanglan silang moadto alang sa usa ka miting sa negosyo.
translation.tgt: They need to go for a business meeting.

translation.src: [FORMAL] Apinigan nato si Magsaysay karung iliksiyun
translation.tgt: We’ll support Magsaysay this coming election

translation.src: [FORMAL] Nagdalyang lang ang pagkaun sa lamisa
translation.tgt: The food on the table is in overflowing quantities

translation.src: [FORMAL] Wa ka baliwa. Tiguwang ka na makigminyug diyisisayis?
translation.tgt: Are you out of your mind? At your age you want to marry a sixteen-year-old?

translation.src: [FORMAL] Ang runway mahimong adunay mga isyu sa traksyon.
translation.tgt: The runway may have traction issues.

translation.src: [FORMAL] Muadbans akug singku para sa kumpra
translation.tgt: I would like to have five pesos in advance for shopping

translation.src: [FORMAL] Oo, sa walay palad ang tubig nahugawan bag-o lang.
translation.tgt: Yes, unfortunately the water has been polluted recently.

translation.src: [FORMAL] Pising lig-un ang ibantal sa magasin
translation.tgt: Use a strong string to bundle the magazine

translation.src: [FORMAL] Ania ang posisyon nga imong gipangita.
translation.tgt: Here is the position you're looking for.

translation.src: [FORMAL] Muhumpay (mahumpay) ang kasakit kun manghaplas kag linimintu
translation.tgt: The pain will be relieved when you rub liniment on it

translation.src: [STREET] Kol, nahitabo sa ilang kaso sa trapik sa duwa. Tol. Ambi lang kaha. Giatay nimo.
translation.tgt: They encountered heavy traffic on the way.

translation.src: [FORMAL] Arang-arang (maarang-arang) ning akung sapatus sa imuha
translation.tgt: My shoes are a bit better than yours

translation.src: [FORMAL] Ako siyang gibusla (gibuslahan) arun matin-aw ang tanan
translation.tgt: I confronted her so that everything would be cleared

translation.src: [FORMAL] Nagkagidlay lagi ku kay gibyaan sa uyab
translation.tgt: I’m a miserable wretch since my lover left me

translation.src: [FORMAL] Dili, dili ako nagbaligya og mga hinagiban.
translation.tgt: No, I am not trafficking weapons.

translation.src: [FORMAL] Wala siya mag-alinga sa daghang tawung nagpaabut kaniya
translation.tgt: He paid no attention to the people waiting for him

translation.src: [FORMAL] Bidang nakahinayak nimug asin sa sabaw
translation.tgt: You put too much salt in the soup

translation.src: [FORMAL] Oo, nabuhat ko. Lisod ang pagginhawa.
translation.tgt: Yes, I did. It was difficult to breathe.

translation.src: [STREET] Diin man. Giatay ko sa imo desisyon.
translation.tgt: That's fine with me. I trust your judgment.

translation.src: [STREET] Kol, paano kung mag-atake sa akoa ang uba?
translation.tgt: But what if someone tries to overtake me?

translation.src: [FORMAL] Nganong dili man ko manigarilyo? Kinahanglan nako kini aron makapahulay!
translation.tgt: Why can't I smoke? I need it to relax!

translation.src: [STREET] Bai, mga kalsada mahadlohay sa tag-araw.
translation.tgt: Yes, these roads can get snowed in during the winter.

translation.src: [STREET] Kol, gihatag na lang unta kamo sa cargo handler bisan kung unsaon niana.
translation.tgt: Sure, we will provide cargo handlers for you.

translation.src: [FORMAL] Dili sila mubayad ug dili apikihun
translation.tgt: They won’t pay if you don’t press them

translation.src: [STREET] Oo, naa ko diha karugda ug oras.
translation.tgt: Yes, I will be there in an hour.

translation.src: [FORMAL] Dili, dili ko gusto nga hugasan nimo ang akong buhok. Mahimo nako kini unya.
translation.tgt: No, I don't want you to wash my hair. I can do it later.

translation.src: [FORMAL] Kinahanglang brikun (ibrik) nimu kining labaya arun ka makaigwalis
translation.tgt: You must make a break on this throw if you want to even up the score

translation.src: [FORMAL] Nagkabulibuli kug bayad sa akung mga utang
translation.tgt: I’m going crazy trying to pay my various debts

translation.src: [FORMAL] Paningkamutan nako ang tanan aron matabangan ka.
translation.tgt: I'll try my best to help you.

translation.src: [FORMAL] Larawan sa kabuhung ang tawung adunahan
translation.tgt: A rich man is a picture of affluence

translation.src: [STREET] Sige, kinsa ang amo sa sasakyan ni?
translation.tgt: Who is the master of this vessel?

translation.src: [FORMAL] Makagangkap kaha ka sa imung abangan dinhi?
translation.tgt: Do you think you can meet the entire rental payment?

translation.src: [FORMAL] Ug manuburnu ka atakihun ka sa mga piryudista
translation.tgt: If you give bribes, the newspapers will attack you

translation.src: [FORMAL] Mibuswak sa iyang mga ngabil ang kalit nga pahiyum
translation.tgt: A sudden smile flashed onto her lips

translation.src: [FORMAL] Pasayloa, dili kami makahatag og refueling sa pagkakaron.
translation.tgt: Sorry, we are unable to provide refueling at the moment.

translation.src: [FORMAL] Pila na ka babayi ang niagi kaniya?
translation.tgt: How many women have gone through his hands?

translation.src: [FORMAL] Dili ako usa sa pagsunod sa mga mando.
translation.tgt: I'm not one for following orders.

translation.src: [FORMAL] Nababag ang ilang kaun sa nasakit ang amahan
translation.tgt: Their meals got to be irregular and scanty when their father got sick

translation.src: [FORMAL] Di ku makaabut ug palit niana
translation.tgt: I can’t afford to buy that

translation.src: [STREET] Bai, dali na kog mas daghan ug panawagan!
translation.tgt: Wow, I can see better now! Thank you!

translation.src: [FORMAL] Dili kana ang husto nga paghubad. Kini kinahanglan nga 'Katunga / Kasukoan'.
translation.tgt: That's not the right translation. It should be 'Katunga / Kasukoan'.

translation.src: [FORMAL] Wala ko gituyo nga nakalapas sa balaod. Palihug hunahunaa pag-usab.
translation.tgt: I didn't intentionally break the law. Please reconsider.

translation.src: [FORMAL] Mituo ko nimo. Palihug buhata ang imong labing maayo aron matabangan ako.
translation.tgt: I believe you. Please do your best to help me.

translation.src: [FORMAL] Imuimu nang imung gidangatan. Wa kay kapasanginlan
translation.tgt: What happened to you is your own doing. You have no one to blame but yourself

translation.src: [FORMAL] Nagkabugo ka na man run. Di na man kang kasiyat sa bula
translation.tgt: You’re getting poorer and poorer. You can’t even shoot the ball

translation.src: [STREET] Kailangan mo makadungan pagdunggan ka sa anak.
translation.tgt: You need to sleep as much as the child does.

translation.src: [STREET] Gawas man, adunay ako akong mga tanglad ha.
translation.tgt: Yes, I have my fishing nets out.

translation.src: [FORMAL] Bagatan (ibagat) ku ning akung humay ug isda
translation.tgt: I will barter my rice for fish

translation.src: [FORMAL] Ang lubut sa kahun nahulba kay bug-at ang gisulud
translation.tgt: The bottom of the box gave way because s.t. heavy was put inside it

translation.src: [FORMAL] Ang vaginal bleeding ba moabot ug mawala?
translation.tgt: Does the vaginal bleeding come and go?

translation.src: [FORMAL] Wa makahimusak (makapanghimusak) ang humay kay wa man abunuhi
translation.tgt: The rice did not bear in abundance because it wasn’t fertilized

translation.src: [FORMAL] Salamat sa imong suporta. Makapadasig nga adunay nag-atiman sa kahimsog sa akong anak.
translation.tgt: Thank you for your support. It's reassuring to have someone taking care of my child's health.

translation.src: [FORMAL] Nahinug na ning akung ulu sa pagpinakungpakung
translation.tgt: My head has become soft because I’ve bumped it so often

translation.src: [FORMAL] Gatudgatud na ang punuan sa lubi kay gisigihan man niyag tigbas
translation.tgt: The coconut trunk is rough because he always chops at it with his bolo

translation.src: [FORMAL] Dili ba kita adunay daghang mga barko? Kuwarenta dili igo.
translation.tgt: Can't we have more ships? Forty won't be enough.

translation.src: [FORMAL] Antis nimu lung-aga na, hugasi usa
translation.tgt: Wash it before you cook it

translation.src: [STREET] Ambi, sa imo Dios, kitang kaila ni.
translation.tgt: Thank goodness, we really need it.

translation.src: [FORMAL] Makabikang (makapabikang) ning mga silya sa akung paglampasu
translation.tgt: These chairs make it all the harder to get the floor scrubbed

translation.src: [FORMAL] Lisud kang sakwatun kay mamug-at ka
translation.tgt: You are hard to lift because you make yourself rigid

translation.src: [FORMAL] Pag-inom sa gireseta nga tambal nga antimalarial ug siguroha nga mapanalipdan nimo ang imong kaugalingon gikan sa pinaakan sa lamok.
translation.tgt: Take prescribed antimalarial medication and ensure you protect yourself from mosquito bites.

translation.src: [FORMAL] Nagbusug na ang bata. Dad-a siya sa uspital
translation.tgt: The baby is struggling to come out. Bring her to the hospital

translation.src: [FORMAL] Sure, happy ko nga musakay sa iyaha.
translation.tgt: Sure, I'm happy to ride with her.

translation.src: [FORMAL] Dili, nasipyat ko sa tren sa pipila ka segundo.
translation.tgt: No, I missed the train by a few seconds.

translation.src: [FORMAL] Di aku mubatuk sa akung mga labaw
translation.tgt: I will not oppose my superiors

translation.src: [FORMAL] Aduna bay laing paagi sa pagkuha niini? Gidumtan ko ang pagtulon sa mga pildoras.
translation.tgt: Is there another way to take it? I hate swallowing pills.

translation.src: [FORMAL] Ang hilisgutan niini nga artikulo mao ang pagbag-o sa klima.
translation.tgt: The subject of this article is climate change.

translation.src: [FORMAL] Namatay siya. Naatakan man sa mata
translation.tgt: He died because he got the bulging eye disease

translation.src: [FORMAL] Nagkabayayat na karun ang iyang pamisti nga naminyo na siya
translation.tgt: She has become slovenly in her manner of dressing now that she’s married

translation.src: [FORMAL] Gidipusitu niya ang alahas sa kaha di yiru
translation.tgt: He deposited the jewelry in the safe

translation.src: [FORMAL] Kami adunay usa ka puno nga tangke sa gasolina, gibana-bana nga 10,000 ka litro.
translation.tgt: We have a full tank of fuel, approximately 10,000 liters.

translation.src: [FORMAL] Kung dili ka maoperahan, basin mawala kini
translation.tgt: If we do not operate, you may lose this.

translation.src: [FORMAL] Imu tang atngan ang trak arun makasakay ta
translation.tgt: You should watch for the bus so that we can get on

translation.src: [FORMAL] Ingkiba lang nang tansan kay way abridur
translation.tgt: Just bite off the bottle cap because we don’t have an opener

translation.src: [FORMAL] Nahigalam na siyag sulugsulug kay di man suklan
translation.tgt: He has been encouraged to keep teasing because nobody stands up to him

translation.src: [FORMAL] Kita giyuy muabaga (mangabaga) aning prugramaha
translation.tgt: We must undertake to carry out this program

translation.src: [FORMAL] Gidiligahan ka sa pag-atiman sa mga bata
translation.tgt: You’re entrusted with taking care of the children

translation.src: [FORMAL] Hudhura ang mga sagbut sa daplin sa dalan
translation.tgt: Scrape out the weeds growing at the edges of the road

translation.src: [STREET] Tol, nagalang kita para tabangi kamo.
translation.tgt: We are here to help you.

translation.src: [FORMAL] Pila ka adlaw naa kay pamamanhid o tingling?
translation.tgt: How many days have you have the numbness or tingling?

translation.src: [FORMAL] Ang huntahunta sa sayal sa baylirina
translation.tgt: The tiers of the ballerina’s dress

translation.src: [FORMAL] Makalilisang kana! Dili nako mahunahuna nga adunay kasakit sa lebel 10.
translation.tgt: That's horrible! I can't imagine having a pain at a level 10.

translation.src: [STREET] Dugaya, wala ko gusto sa akong tiyan!
translation.tgt: I don't want anything in my throat!

translation.src: [FORMAL] Nagkahanuy na ang dagan sa awtu nga maayu na ang dalan
translation.tgt: The car is running more smoothly now that the road is better

translation.src: [FORMAL] Di ku makakaug sud-an nga giagi ug mantika
translation.tgt: I can’t eat food that was cooked in fat

translation.src: [FORMAL] Nganong kinahanglan nimo ang navigator? Sa akong hunahuna ang copilot makahimo niini.
translation.tgt: Why do you need the navigator? I think the copilot can handle it.

translation.src: [FORMAL] Oo, kini sa tuo nga bahin.
translation.tgt: Yes, it's on the right side.

translation.src: [FORMAL] Kinahanglang mahibaloan gayod nato ang iyang panglantaw. Importante kini.
translation.tgt: We really need to know his perspective. This is important.

translation.src: [FORMAL] Isulti kanako ang eksaktong numero sa runway.
translation.tgt: Tell me the exact runway number.

translation.src: [FORMAL] Ug dipdipun ang sagbut hayan mamatay
translation.tgt: If you cut the grass short, it will die

translation.src: [FORMAL] Pagkaingun ugma u sunud ba hinug na na
translation.tgt: Tomorrow or the next day, it will be ripe

translation.src: [FORMAL] Gipresentar na nako kini para sa customs inspection
translation.tgt: I have already presented this for customs inspection

translation.src: [FORMAL] Hudlatun nila ang isda paingun sa baling
translation.tgt: They are frightening the fish into going to the net

translation.src: [STREET] Giatay ko, Ambi tanan nako ug mas daling direksyon ha?
translation.tgt: I'm a bit lost. Can you give me more directions?

translation.src: [FORMAL] Namatikdan, among sigurohon nga ang imong mga kinahanglanon sa kuryente matuman.
translation.tgt: Noted, we will make sure your power requirements are met.

translation.src: [FORMAL] Dili ba mahimo nga daghang mga pulis? Kinahanglan nato sila.
translation.tgt: Can't we have more policemen? We need them.

translation.src: [FORMAL] Abir, lisua nag hinay dungan sa pagtulbuk ari
translation.tgt: Let’s see now, turn that slowly and press this at the same time

translation.src: [FORMAL] Mualingabngab (maalingabngab) nang imung samad ug di tahiun
translation.tgt: If you don’t stitch that wound, it will gape

translation.src: [FORMAL] Asi, bag-u ta run ug sapatus
translation.tgt: My! I see we have new shoes today

translation.src: [FORMAL] Dili, ako wala. Nganong nangutana ka?
translation.tgt: No, I didn't. Why do you ask?

translation.src: [FORMAL] Oo, ang akong anak miagi sa ihi karong buntag.
translation.tgt: Yes, my child passed urine this morning.

translation.src: [STREET] Piskot, dili nako gusto magpa-disklubre sa amo kuwerder.
translation.tgt: I would rather not disclose the identity of my employer.
